section.title: Warm Up Activity
section.para: Let's try to find at least one solution to \(x^2− 2x − 35 = 0\).

list.item: Create a table of values. In column 1, enter the whole numbers between 0 and 10 to represent values of x. In column 2, evaluate the expression \(x^2-2x-35\) using the values for \(x\).

problem.para: Write down your answers, then select the solution button to compare your work.

solution.para: We can see from the table that a solution to the equation is \(x = 7\) since \(x^2- 2x - 35 = 0\) at that value.

div.para: The other zero for the equation is located at \(x=-5\), but it is possible that you did not consider negative numbers.

list.item: There is another number outside of 0 to 10 that would make the expression \(x^2− 2x − 35\) equal 0. Can you find it?

solution.para: Enter the number outside of 0 to 10 that would make the expression \(x^2− 2x − 35\) equal 0.
